paper_title: The Grenoble Axion Haloscope platform (GrAHal): development plan and first results
notes: First pathfinding run of GrAHal haloscope at liquid He temperature sets g_agamma <= 2.2e-13 GeV^-1 around 6.375 GHz (m_a ~ 26.37 ueV) at 95% CL, assuming axions constitute all local DM density. Only a single representative limit value is given in the text; the full exclusion curve is in Fig. 4 but no numerical table provided. Local DM density value not explicitly stated numerically. | Vision: GrAHal first-result exclusion is a narrow magenta band around 6.375 GHz (~2.6e-5 eV), much weaker than other haloscopes. The plot is a compilation of many experiments; GrAHal's own constraint is a thin vertical feature near 2.6e-5 eV reaching down to roughly 1e-13 GeV^-1. Data points are approximate. | CV axis calibration succeeded (ranges consistent with LLM) | Calibration: No calibration needed (benchmark KSVZ raw_ratio=0.77 snapped to identity)
